name: double-entry-ledger
description: Double-entry bookkeeping for agent harnesses, as two skills: a runtime ledger (balanced state changes, tool-call intents cleared against code-measured probes, Claude Code hooks, multi-agent budgets that must net to zero) and a landing ledger (design decisions as debits, one voucher per debit from the implementer, mechanical checks and a high-precision gate, reverse scan for unwired code).
